music.prompt: Sparse bouncy percussion at 122 BPM starting instantly on the first beat: conga hits, rim clicks and hand claps with a strong dub delay so every hit echoes and repeats, a muted kick on every beat, building tension and getting busier toward the end. Percussion only: no melody, no chords, no bass notes, no vocals.

Upbeat Afro house track at 122 BPM that starts immediately at full energy and full volume on the very first beat, with no quiet intro, no build-up and no fade-in: driving four-on-the-floor kick, shakers and congas, warm rolling bass, bright piano chords and a catchy plucked kalimba riff. Joyful, warm and confident, like a modern product launch. Full energy all the way through with no breakdown and no big ending hit; the groove just keeps rolling. No vocals, no singing.
